newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Thailand rural telecom sector gets $100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Thailand rural telecom sector gets $100 mln loan.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank has approved a $100 million loan to partly finance Thailand's third rural telecommunications project.
The project is aimed at providing public long-distance telephone facilities to 43,000 still unserved villages, mostly in north and northeastern Thailand, the bank said in a statement.
The total cost of the project, which includes the purchase of switching and transmission equipment, outside plant and terminal equipment, is estimated at $660 million.
The loan is to be sourced out of the bank's ordinary capital resources, which carries an interest rate of 6.82 percent per annum and is repayable over 24 years with a grace period of four years.
